messages:
sophia: Thanks for the great all-hands. Quick follow-up for the security/compliance thread: customers are asking for one concise place that answers: SOC2 vs ISO timelines, VPC private control plane capabilities (peering, private endpoints, DNS), exact audit-log fields & default retention, and BYOK/key rotation behavior. Can we list owners and next steps?

sec_bot: Posted compliance deck + tracking issues to the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.com/security/compliance. Made an office-hours RSVP: https://cal.com/redwood/security-officehours.

zoe: Short answers: SOC2 Type II audit window target = Oct 2026 (controls in place by Aug 2026). ISO 27001 readiness assessment planned for Aug; certification target H1 2027. We'll publish the controls mapping next week.

luke: Audit logs: v1 schema emits these fields: ts, service, model_id, model_version, request_id, route, token_in, token_out, latency_ms, actor_id. Hosted default: prompt_text redacted/truncated in UI and exports; 90-day retention for hosted audit view. Private: customers can export full events to their storage and control retention. Example event we plan to emit: ```{"ts":"2026-09-02T11:22:33Z","service":"inference","model_id":"redwood-13b-v3","model_version":"v3.0","request_id":"req_0C3F","route":"/v1/generate","token_in":14,"token_out":87}```

mike_sales: Sales asked about including model_hash / quant_profile in logs for exact reproducibility. Also want a one-pager for field with dos/don'ts.

anya: KMS/BYOK: Private supports customer-managed KMS now (AWS/GCP/Azure). We use envelope encryption. Key rotation: customers rotate keys in their KMS and then call our rekey API; we publish a rotation playbook. HSM-backed BYOK (FIPS level) is planned as a limited alpha in Q4 2026. Note: rotating keys can affect long-lived KV caches and may require re-encryption steps we document.

zoe: For model provenance: schema v2 roadmap includes model_hash and quant_profile; target for v2 roll-out = within this quarter. For now model_version + model_id should let you map to a release.

luke: Action owners and deliverables I propose: (1) @zoe publish SOC2/ISO timeline + controls mapping, (2) @luke publish audit-log schema v1 + sample exports and ingest recipes, (3) @anya publish BYOK rotation guide + HSM roadmap, (4) @mike_sales coordinate a 1-pager for sales/solutions, (5) security-bot schedule office hours and convert thread to checklist.

sophia: Sounds good. Can we get ETA on each deliverable? Rough is fine.

zoe: SOC2 controls doc by 2026-06-30.

luke: Audit-log schema + sample exports and BigQuery/ELK recipes by 2026-06-25.

anya: BYOK rotation guide draft by 2026-07-05; HSM alpha plan by 2026-09-30.

mike_sales: 1-pager draft for field by 2026-06-28.

sec_bot: Tasks created: [soc2-controls-doc], [audit-log-schema], [byok-rotation-guide], [sales-1pager], [office-hours]. Will ping owners at 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

mike_sales: FYI, I'll surface the 1-pager to priority customers and collect any gap questions.

sophia: Thanks everyone. If you want early VPC beta signups DM @luke. We'll triage remaining questions in office hours.
